title: Deep Learning-Based Stage-Wise Risk Stratification for Early Lung Adenocarcinoma in CT Images: A Multi-Center Study.
summary: A two-stage 3D deep-learning system classified early lung adenocarcinoma nodules from CT and was checked against surgical pathology, multi-center data and radiologist performance.
ai_technology: stage-wise CT model and multi-center sets; Results report pathology-grounded model validation and slice-thickness/radiologist comparisons.
